returns date
language sql
stable
as $$
  select case
    when coalesce(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.valid_until', true), '') <> ''
         then (current_setting('request.jwt.claim.valid_until', true))::date
    else current_date
  end;

);

  public.resident_unit_id() is not null
  and not revoked

  and (
    select count(*)
    from public.permits p
    where p.unit_id = public.resident_unit_id()
      and not p.revoked
